source.title: Oklahoma DEQ Laboratory Accreditation Program — Accredited_Labs_2026 GIS roster + State Environmental Laboratory Services private-well path (Water Test Request / Sample Collection Assistance / Private Well Analysis / Home Water Testing)
limitations: Primary roster: OK DEQ ArcGIS feature layer Accredited_Labs_2026 (MapServer layer 6), queried Physical_State='OK' on 18 September 2026 (100 in-state features).

BusinessCa values on the GIS layer include Commercial, Permittee, Industrial/Induistrial, Muncipality/Municipal, Field laboratory Accreditation, and Research. Only BusinessCa=Commercial rows are tabulated (except state SELS and state agriculture).
GIS layer does not include the web search app's 'Commercial Sample' column — private-well acceptance marked unknown for all commercial rows; call first.

Parameter-level accreditation is not on this GIS export — DEQ says contact Laboratory Accreditation at 405-702-1000 or labaccreditation@deq.ok.gov to verify a lab is accredited for a particular parameter.

Municipal / utility labs omitted from commercial table: 9 (City of Lawton; City Of OKC WTP Lab Hefner; City of Norman -WTP Lab; City of Edmond Water Resources Micro Lab; City of Midwest City; City of Durant; City of Tulsa Microbiology / Wet Chemistry / Instrumentation).
OK DEQ State Env. Lab (State Principal Laboratory) omitted from commercial table — documented in verified SELS private-well path.
Ok Dept. of Ag-Laboratory omitted from commercial table as state agriculture laboratory.
Permittee (58), Industrial/Induistrial (12), Field laboratory Accreditation (1), and Research (1; Oklahoma Water Survey/OU) omitted from commercial table.
Out-of-state labs appear on the nationwide Accredited_Labs_2026 layer but were excluded by Physical_State='OK' filter — use the official DEQ lab search for out-of-state options.
Fees appear on Water Test Request / Lab Services Fees pages but are intentionally omitted from public HTML — confirm current amounts with SELS.
No downloadable current PDF drinking-water lab list found (obsolete 2005–2006 Digital Prairie list not used).

verified_paths.name: OK DEQ State Environmental Laboratory Services — private Total Coliform / E. coli
verified_paths.notes: SELS publishes private Total Coliform & E. coli sampling instructions (SM 9223B). Samples must be returned within 28 hours; do not ship Friday or weekend. Kits/supplies via Water Test Request form, phone 405-702-1000, or email selsd@deq.ok.gov. Delivery: courier to 707 N. Robinson, Oklahoma City, OK 73102; USPS to P.O. Box 1677, Oklahoma City, OK 73102; personal delivery Mon–Fri 8:00 a.m.–4:30 p.m. (except state holidays) at Sample Management Unit (northeast corner). Technical Assistance page states there are no state rules requiring private-well testing; lenders often require Total Coliform and E. coli.

verified_paths.name: OK DEQ State Environmental Laboratory Services — private chemistry / Water Wellness
verified_paths.notes: Water Test Request form offers private-well tests including Nitrate/Nitrite, Lead, and Water Wellness panel (chloride, sulfate, conductivity, pH, hardness, nitrate/nitrite, copper, lead, iron, manganese, sodium per Private Well Analysis fact sheet). Private Nitrate + Nitrite sampling instructions require return within 48 hours in DEQ bottle. Home Water Testing fact sheet (10/2024) recommends annual total coliform, nitrate/nitrite, conductivity, and pH for private supplies. Confirm current fees via Laboratory Services Fees page — amounts intentionally not republished here.
